[CONCEPT]: X-ray style visualization of a full human body (biological subject)
[CAMERA/LAYOUT]: centered hero shot
[REFERENCE USE]: Use the uploaded image as strict pose/framing reference.

[CORE DESCRIPTION]:
Create a highly detailed X-ray style visualization of a full human body. Show major internal structures clearly with high legibility. The viewer must be able to clearly see the internal architecture, components, and relationships.

[LIGHTING & RENDERING]:
Render using luminous internal highlighting, subtle subsurface scattering. Ensure clean surface separation.

[ENVIRONMENT & PALETTE]:
Use a pure pitch black background, zero clutter. The color palette should feature cyan, blue, and luminous white accents. Prioritize clarity, legibility, and a strong visual hierarchy over unnecessary visual chaos.

[NEGATIVE PROMPT]:
cluttered background, random scenery, sloppy labels, unreadable text, cartoon style, messy effects, opaque exterior blocking internals, gore, blood, exposed flesh, horror, injury, deformed anatomy, body horror
